vps.config.title: Village Path Smoothed
vps.config.resetAllDone: Every option is back at its default; press Save & Close to keep it.
vps.config.scopeHint: Takes effect for worlds and chunks generated after saving; existing roads stay as they are.
vps.config.invalidHint: A field is red: fix it, or press its Default button to save.
vps.config.invalidSave: Not saved: a field is still invalid.
vps.config.enabled: Enabled by default for new worlds
vps.config.enabled.tooltip: Seed value for worlds without their own switch. Every world keeps its own setting in <world>/village_path_smoothed.json, changed in game with /vps world on|off.
vps.config.roadSmoothing.tooltip: Master switch for the whole rewrite. Off = villages generate exactly like vanilla.
vps.config.objective.tooltip: SMOOTH FIRST ranks cliff penalty > total step count > deviation from the terrain. MIN DEVIATION weighs deviation and steps together. SHORTEST CATCHUP hugs the terrain. HYBRID blends both.
vps.config.roadShapeStage.tooltip: T1 5 solves the profile and shifts buildings while the structure is assembled. T5 is the legacy solve at feature placement: real heightmap, but buildings never move. T5 is the fallback and the A/B comparison.
vps.config.probeCaliber.tooltip: Which heights the T5 solve reads. CENTER WINDOW keeps the vanilla +/-1 chunk real-heightmap window but anchors it on the village bounding box, so the result no longer depends on which chunk triggered the solve. ALL NOISE drops the window and probes noise everywhere. Ignored on the T1.5 path, which is always pure noise.
vps.config.allowCut.tooltip: Lets the road dig into slopes instead of stepping over them. The promise is about the noise model, not the generated world.
vps.config.protectBuildings.tooltip: The writer skips a claimed column whose road block would land inside a building's real body or interior. The empty part of a bounding box is still written.
vps.config.roadSurfaceDetection.tooltip: TEMPLATE Y0 SOLID takes the y0 street surface connected to the y1 street connectors; farmland, water and terracotta stay vanilla scenery. TEMPLATE Y0 ROAD MATERIAL takes only the style's own road block (connector cells still join).
vps.config.includeTownCenters.tooltip: Only the plaza's road-material cells join the mask, so the fountain, bell and logs keep their vanilla blocks. Off leaves plazas entirely vanilla.
vps.config.kerb.tooltip: Wraps the first side column where terrain rises beside the road, with a leaf railing on top of each run.
vps.config.kerb.minDropHeight.tooltip: The two-column probe top must rise more than this many whole blocks above the road before a kerb is built.
vps.config.railing.tooltip: Leaf railings at the road edge wherever the walkable ground drops away. Beside water the threshold is overridden.
vps.config.railing.minDropHeight.tooltip: The drop must exceed this many whole blocks. The known-in-game setting is 1; raising it makes villages read as unfenced.
vps.config.railing.skipAtDoors.tooltip: Keeps the 3x3 in front of a movable building's main door free of drop railings and kerb-top leaves, so a doorway can never be fenced in.
vps.config.waterCrossing.tooltip: Places scaffolding as the walk surface over water. Off keeps the vanilla road there.
vps.config.waterCrossing.distanceWhenSup: Scaffolding distance state where a sturdy face sits below. The default 0 matches vanilla's own supported value.
vps.config.waterCrossing.distanceWhenUns: Distance state everywhere else - one value for the whole unsupported span. Unsupported spans still decay on their first tick; that is vanilla scaffolding behaviour, not a defect.
vps.config.maxFillLayers.tooltip: How many blocks of support the writer may stack under a road that sits above the ground; beyond it the cell becomes a bridge deck. -1 = unlimited. Writer-side only: it never influences the solve.
vps.config.maxClearLayers.tooltip: How many layers above the road are cleared when it sits below the ground; beyond it the cell becomes a tunnel with a lined ceiling. -1 = unlimited. Default 4 keeps the cap-formed ceiling and its light visible.
vps.config.stepViolationPenalty.tooltip: Soft-constraint cost per half block of drop above the legal limit. Higher values trade deviation from the terrain for fewer cliffs; the residual is counted in /vps stats either way.
vps.config.dpWindowHalfUnits.tooltip: Per-cell candidate half window, shrunk automatically for wide slices. Shrinking it below about 4 freezes the region solver on its seed. Note it does not widen the seam between a crossing and its streets.
vps.config.maxExactSectionWidth.tooltip: Slices up to this width are solved by the exact arm DP; wider areas go through iterative minimisation. If every street is wider, a village degenerates into one giant region and the exact DP never runs (counted in /vps stats).
vps.config.icmRounds.tooltip: Iterative minimisation rounds for wide regions. 0 freezes a region on its seed.
vps.config.hybridWeightDeviation.tooltip: Weight w1 of the HYBRID objective (w2 = 1). Only read when the objective is HYBRID.
vps.config.maxBuildingShift.tooltip: Cap on a building component's vertical shift in whole blocks. 0 = unlimited, so only the world height clamps it.
vps.config.buildingShiftMedianWingBlocks: When greater than 0, the chosen shift is clamped to that many whole blocks around the legacy median scheme's shift. 0 = off.
vps.config.surfaceDeviationWarnBlocks.to: A written road this many whole blocks away from the real terrain logs one WARN per village. It never corrects geometry and never falls back to vanilla roads.
vps.config.buildingGuard.tooltip: Counts floating or buried moved components in /vps stats. Diagnostic only: it never repairs and never reverts a shift.
vps.config.roadPiecesRegex.tooltip: Which structure pieces may join the road mask. The default takes streets, terminators and town centres of every vanilla village style. A plain string or an invalid regex is flagged red and blocks saving. Only for data packs and diagnostics; a custom value also makes /vps dump accept third-party villages.
vps.config.fillMaterial.tooltip: STYLE ROAD keeps the per-style vanilla support fill (dirt path, sand). Any other value is read as a block id such as minecraft:dirt and overrides it.
vps.config.beardCompensation.tooltip: Legacy: blocks added to the noise probe next to buildings. Keep 0 - the old +1 compensated the vanilla beard but put doorways on a bump real terrain does not have. Raise only for A/B comparisons.
vps.config.beardRadius.tooltip: Horizontal radius of the beard zone around building footprints. Only used by the step kernel.
vps.config.beardKernel.tooltip: step is the legacy flat step inside the radius; beard thin is vanilla's closed form. beard thin is implemented and tested but its density-to-block factor is NOT calibrated, so enabling it before calibration looks worse than no compensation.
vps.config.beardKernelBlocksPerDensity.t: beard thin only: surface blocks per unit of vanilla beard density. 1.0 is a guess, not a measurement.
vps.config.kerb.blockByStyle.tooltip: Block id used for a kerb wall in that village style. Lowercase minecraft ids only; an unknown id falls back to the built-in default for that style.
vps.config.railing.leavesByStyle.tooltip: Leaf block id used for that village style's railings. Lowercase minecraft ids only; an unknown id falls back to the built-in default for that style.
vps.config.diagnostics.dumpRoadNetwork.t: Writes one line per solved village to the log: cells, arms, regions. Useful when comparing two settings.
vps.config.diagnostics.maxRoadCellsPerVi: Safety cap on how many cells one village may contribute to the mask. A village past it is skipped with a warning instead of being solved.
vps.config.debug.disableVillagerBrains.t: Villagers stand still (their brain tick is skipped) so you can inspect generated roads. Trading still works. Also togglable with /vps debug villagerbrain freeze on|off.
vps.config.debug.seamSigns.tooltip: One standing sign per solved-mask seam, naming both cells and the cause when the half-block promise breaks. Visibility beats fidelity: the sign replaces whatever occupies the cell and may float.
vps.config.debug.doorSigns.tooltip: One standing sign per movable building's main door: door X/Z with the base walk level, the selected road cell with its solved surface, the real door floor, and NO FRONT when the door had no eligible outward cell.
vps.createWorld.enabled.tooltip: Smooth village roads with slab steps during world generation. The switch applies to the world being created (saved per world); existing worlds keep their own setting.
